paper_metadata.title: Enhancing high-temperature mechanical performance of Mg-Gd-Y alloys via multi-pass cold rolling induced deformation twins

evidence.quote: the effect of preset deformation twins on the high-temperature strength of Mg – 8.5Gd – 3Y – 0.5Zr (wt%) and Mg – 8.5Gd – 3Y – 2Cu – 0.5Zr (wt%) alloys was investigated

A thermomechanical strategy was developed to enhance the high-temperature mechanical performance of Mg–RE alloys without increasing RE content, through the introduction of preset twins by multi-pass cold rolling.

Microstructural analysis revealed that thermally stable twin boundaries effectively impeded dislocation motion, leading to dense dislocation entanglement and localized strain accumulation, which enhanced strain hardening and elevated high-temperature strength.
Consequently, a synergistic strengthening effect is expected between the preset twin networks and the LPSO phase, jointly contributing to the superior high-temperature performance of the alloy.
